item: Seventeen dead top-level functions and one dead type nobody called are deleted (A-037, C12 part 1, R446)
key_paths: src/analytics/equivalence.py; src/analytics/lunar.py; src/analytics/translation_store.py; src/api/diagnostics/bundle.py; src/api/main.py; src/backup/attribution.py; src/backup/import_reports.py; src/backup/parity.py; src/briefing/producers.py; src/catalog/provenance_scope.py; src/database/__init__.py; src/database/models.py; src/database/session.py; src/database/source_manager.py; src/monitoring/search_timing.py; src/monitoring/unlock_marker.py; tests/test_search_timing_wired.py
summary: Top-level names in unowned files with no caller in src, src/static, scripts, configs, migrations or tests (rg -w over each name, re-run by Plan for the four that looked dynamic) are deleted: ring_terms, candidate_languages, _pearson_centered, record_tentative_batch, attribution_markdown, _report_outcome, _small_corpus_note, query_data, store_data, search_collection, get_source_manager, close_session, last_done_at, _python_sort_key, _load_padded, curated_filter, instrument_search, and the type CompressedJSON. Five comments or docstrings that named instrument_search or the deleted sort key were reworded (the live search path builds its timer directly). Imports they alone used went with them. No behaviour change. Left alone on purpose: the lane-owned names (WAL, OSM, RC2, and Export's app_is_locked in api/unlock.py, R449), unicode_withheld_traceback (passphrase-rule file), SpellDelete, LinkClassificationRule and SourceCredibilityRule (mapped tables: a drop-table migration is deferred past 0.6, R452), the test-only names. Release-notes line: internal cleanup, nothing an operator sees; no behaviour changes.
